task_completion.description: Agent successfully connects to the 'demodb' database using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the OrientDB Studio or console connected to 'demodb' with the 'Profiles' class visible.

task_completion.description: Agent adds the 'CustomerTier' property of type STRING to the 'Profiles' class.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Schema view or command output showing 'CustomerTier' added to the 'Profiles' class properties.

task_completion.description: Agent executes a query to calculate total spending by summing 'Price' from 'Orders' via 'HasOrder' edges.
task_completion.visual_evidence: SQL query visible in the editor or terminal involving 'SUM(out("HasOrder").Price)' or similar logic.

task_completion.description: Agent updates the 'CustomerTier' property for profiles based on the specified spending thresholds (Platinum > 3000, Gold 1000-3000, Silver < 1000).
task_completion.visual_evidence: UPDATE commands or script execution results showing records being modified with 'Platinum', 'Gold', or 'Silver' values.

task_completion.description: Agent exports the list of Platinum customers to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal command (e.g., cat, ls) or file explorer showing /home/ga/platinum_customers.json exists and contains Name, Surname, Email, and CustomerTier.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OrientDB database rather than manually creating a file with dummy data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the OrientDB Studio interface or the 'orientdb>' command-line prompt being used to run queries.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the tracer email into a file but derived the list from database queries.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent's command history should show logic for filtering by spending or tier, not just a direct write of 'vip_tracer@example.com'.

integrity.description: The agent used the exact file path specified in the task rather than a temporary or default location.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export command or file verification must explicitly show the path /home/ga/platinum_customers.json.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The database contains a tracer account 'vip_tracer@example.com' with a total spend of 3500 (orders of 2000 and 1500), which MUST be labeled as 'Platinum' and included in the final JSON. Another tracer 'mid_tracer@example.com' has a spend of 1500 and MUST be labeled 'Gold' (and thus excluded from the JSON). The final JSON file at /home/ga/platinum_customers.json must contain the fields: Name, Surname, Email, and CustomerTier.
